status_legend.MISSING: Module family has no automatic registered converter; presence of a stub is not support.
status_legend.AVAILABLE_BOUNDED: Current native mapping exists with tested/declared limits. Maintain it; not universal fidelity.
status_legend.PARTIAL: Current mapping handles a subset or approximation; the remaining modes need scoped work.
status_legend.PREVIEW_ONLY: Can prepare a preview, but current output cannot pass automatic Apply's form-action guard.
status_legend.IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED: Code exists but the relevant licensed/runtime acceptance remains pending.
status_legend.STRUCTURE_REVIEW: Uses an existing section type, but special structure/options need source fixtures and acceptance.
status_legend.RESEARCH_ONLY: Vendor module identity is documented; exact schema/version/use and target equivalence are not established.
status_legend.OUT_OF_SCOPE_DIVI5: Future input-format expansion; current Divi 4 parser does not support it.
status_legend.LEGACY_VARIANT_REVIEW: Historical source label/schema review; may be the same underlying source identity as Woo Products. Not counted as another independent missing converter.
